audit_scope: source-reviewed worker-4 repair of linked DBAASP literature, assay, and experiment rows against local primary paper text/figures

caution_findings.evidence_context: The packet has no linked_sequence_records rows, so sequence/name verification was performed from Fig. 1A/PDF text rather than a database sequence snapshot.
linked_assay_records and linked_experiment_records represent duplicate DBAASP assay surfaces for the same 12 source-supported IC50 values; both are retained and matched to the same activity records.
